name: Demo I: Move-Like Redline Text Note
description: Exercise a move-like redline operation using a disposable text note target: create a bounded target, prove it is visible, dry-run move, apply move, verify the moved location, and clean up the target.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a model or drafting view that supports text notes and visible-element export.
Keep the generated target text unique per run so repeated live runs cannot match stale notes.
success_criteria: A disposable text note id is created in the requested view.
The created id is visible in the pre-move visible-element inventory with a model-space point.
The /revit/move-elements dry-run reports movedIds covering the created id.
The applied /revit/move-elements response reports movedIds covering the created id.
The post-move visible-element inventory still contains the created id.
The observed model-space delta matches the requested vector within tolerance.
Cleanup dry-run and applied delete evidence cover the created id.
failure_criteria: The text note target is not created or is not visible before the move.
Move dry-run or apply omits the target id.
The target disappears after the move.
The observed model-space delta does not match the requested vector.
Cleanup is requested but native delete effect ids do not cover the target.
grader_notes: This task intentionally uses a disposable created target so repeated live runs prove redline move mechanics without damaging project content.
Do not count generic move success without movedIds or post-move location evidence.
optional_cleanup_steps: Delete the disposable text note after move evidence is recorded.
